images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: wide 16:9 editorial project illustration for a robotics and AI engineer's portfolio. Create a sophisticated high-detail physically rendered 3D technical still life with an isometric three-quarter camera, charcoal and brushed aluminum materials, warm ivory backdrop, restrained violet and chartreuse accents, soft studio lighting and realistic shadows. Contemporary technical editorial art, coherent restrained palette. The central subject and important details must fit within the middle 75% of the frame for responsive cropping. No written text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no screenshots, no invented performance numbers. This is conceptual artwork, not documentary evidence of an actual prototype. Subject: a compact two-wheeled circular research robot with a short open sensor tower and a depth camera, on a small abstract indoor floor plane. Its camera projects a subtle translucent violet vision frustum toward three simple objects (cube, cylinder, small plant); fine glowing wireframe bounding boxes surround those objects. Show a sparse point cloud around object edges, visually explaining robot perception and object detection. No humanoid robot.
